yaml:
# HISS node maintenance prerequisites (node reboot coordination design 2026-10-22, user decision "모두 권고안대로",
# maintenance window daily 02:00-06:00 KST). Setup applies these objects with server-side apply under the
# opensphere-setup-hiss field manager (prepare-hiss); Cluster Manager never creates or changes them. Cluster Manager's
# HISS facility `node-maintenance` installs kured with Helm into opensphere-node-maintenance using the ServiceAccount and
# RBAC below (the chart renders no RBAC), and runs the OS Shell node-maintenance commands.
#
# Design permission numbers: P1 Namespace, P2 ServiceAccount, P3 kured ClusterRole, P4 kured lock Role, P5 Cluster
# Manager executor Role, P6 Cluster Manager Role in monitoring, P7 kured writer fence, P8 workload fence. Added in
# implementation: P9 Cluster Manager operation record (one named ConfigMap in opensphere-console; the existing
# operation-recorder Role is create-only prepared and lists names per catalog entry) and N1 a NetworkPolicy that admits
# only Prometheus to kured's metrics port. kured 1.23.0 never uses `pods delete` while the Eviction API serves (lab
# R0 2026-10-22), so P3 omits it.
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: opensphere-node-maintenance
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
    # kured needs a privileged, hostPID container (nsenter into the host to call systemctl reboot).
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: privileged
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit: privileged
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn: privileged
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: kured
  namespace: opensphere-node-maintenance
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-kured
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
rules:
  # kured 1.23.0 kured-rbac.yaml without `pods delete`: cordon/uncordon, node annotations and the PreferNoSchedule
  # taint (fenced by opensphere-hiss-kured-writer-fence), drain through the Eviction API.
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["nodes"]
    verbs: ["get", "patch"]
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["pods"]
    verbs: ["get", "list"]
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["pods/eviction"]
    verbs: ["create"]
  - apiGroups: ["apps"]
    resources: ["daemonsets"]
    verbs: ["get"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-kured
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: opensphere-hiss-kured
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: kured
    namespace: opensphere-node-maintenance
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-kured-lock
  namespace: opensphere-node-maintenance
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
rules:
  # The cluster-wide reboot lock is an annotation on kured's own DaemonSet.
  - apiGroups: ["apps"]
    resources: ["daemonsets"]
    resourceNames: ["kured"]
    verbs: ["update"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-kured-lock
  namespace: opensphere-node-maintenance
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: opensphere-hiss-kured-lock
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: kured
    namespace: opensphere-node-maintenance
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-node-maintenance-executor
  namespace: opensphere-node-maintenance
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
rules:
  # Helm release of kured (DaemonSet, metrics Service, ServiceMonitor), its release Secrets, and the two
  # PrometheusRules Cluster Manager writes (gates, pause). Every workload this Role can create is fenced by
  # opensphere-hiss-node-maintenance-workload. No RBAC, ServiceAccount, Pod or exec permission.
  - apiGroups: ["apps"]
    resources: ["daemonsets"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch", "create", "update", "patch", "delete"]
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["services", "configmaps", "secrets"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch", "create", "update", "patch", "delete"]
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["pods", "events"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
  - apiGroups: ["monitoring.coreos.com"]
    resources: ["prometheusrules", "servicemonitors"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch", "create", "update", "patch", "delete"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-node-maintenance-executor
  namespace: opensphere-node-maintenance
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: opensphere-hiss-node-maintenance-executor
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: opensphere-cluster-manager-runtime
    namespace: opensphere-console
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-node-maintenance-monitoring
  namespace: monitoring
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
rules:
  # Cluster Manager already may create NetworkPolicies in monitoring; this lets it keep and remove the one that
  # admits kured to Prometheus :9090. The existing Shared Observability executor Role is not changed.
  - apiGroups: ["networking.k8s.io"]
    resources: ["networkpolicies"]
    resourceNames: ["opensphere-prometheus-node-maintenance-access"]
    verbs: ["get", "update", "patch", "delete"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-node-maintenance-monitoring
  namespace: monitoring
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: opensphere-hiss-node-maintenance-monitoring
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: opensphere-cluster-manager-runtime
    namespace: opensphere-console
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-node-maintenance-recorder
  namespace: opensphere-console
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
rules:
  # The HISS operation record of this facility. opensphere-hiss-operation-recorder (create-only prepared) names the
  # records of the earlier catalog entries; creating ConfigMaps is already allowed there.
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["configmaps"]
    resourceNames: ["opensphere-his-operation-node-maintenance"]
    verbs: ["get", "update"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-node-maintenance-recorder
  namespace: opensphere-console
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: opensphere-hiss-node-maintenance-recorder
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: opensphere-cluster-manager-runtime
    namespace: opensphere-console
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: opensphere-node-maintenance-ingress
  namespace: opensphere-node-maintenance
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  # Only Prometheus reaches kured's metrics port; nothing else is served. Egress (API server, Prometheus) is open.
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: ["Ingress"]
  ingress:
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: monitoring
          podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app.kubernetes.io/name: prometheus
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 8080
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-kured-writer-fence
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  # kured's ServiceAccount may change, on a node, only spec.unschedulable, weave.works/kured-* annotations and the
  # weave.works/kured-node-reboot PreferNoSchedule taint. Control-plane nodes are included (rebooting them is kured's
  # job). Its only other writes are Evictions and its own lock annotation (fenced in
  # opensphere-hiss-node-maintenance-workload).
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
      - apiGroups: [""]
        apiVersions: ["v1"]
        operations: ["CREATE", "UPDATE", "DELETE"]
        resources: ["nodes", "nodes/status"]
  matchConditions:
    - name: kured-identity
      expression: "request.userInfo.username == 'system:serviceaccount:opensphere-node-maintenance:kured'"
  variables:
    - name: newAnnotations
      expression: "object != null && has(object.metadata.annotations) ? object.metadata.annotations : {}"
    - name: oldAnnotations
      expression: "oldObject != null && has(oldObject.metadata.annotations) ? oldObject.metadata.annotations : {}"
    - name: newLabels
      expression: "object != null && has(object.metadata.labels) ? object.metadata.labels : {}"
    - name: oldLabels
      expression: "oldObject != null && has(oldObject.metadata.labels) ? oldObject.metadata.labels : {}"
    - name: newTaints
      expression: "object != null ? object.spec.?taints.orValue([]) : []"
    - name: oldTaints
      expression: "oldObject != null ? oldObject.spec.?taints.orValue([]) : []"
  validations:
    - expression: "request.operation == 'UPDATE' && request.?subResource.orValue('') == ''"
      message: "kured may only update a node object (no create, delete or status write)"
    - expression: "variables.newLabels == variables.oldLabels"
      message: "kured may not change node labels"
    - expression: >-
        object.metadata.?ownerReferences.orValue([]) == oldObject.metadata.?ownerReferences.orValue([]) &&
        object.metadata.?finalizers.orValue([]) == oldObject.metadata.?finalizers.orValue([])
      message: "kured may not change node owner references or finalizers (a dangling owner makes the garbage collector delete the node)"
    - expression: >-
        variables.newAnnotations.all(k, k.startsWith('weave.works/kured-') || (k in variables.oldAnnotations && variables.oldAnnotations[k] == variables.newAnnotations[k])) &&
        variables.oldAnnotations.all(k, k.startsWith('weave.works/kured-') || k in variables.newAnnotations)
      message: "kured may change only weave.works/kured-* node annotations"
    - expression: >-
        object.spec.?podCIDR.orValue('') == oldObject.spec.?podCIDR.orValue('') &&
        object.spec.?podCIDRs.orValue([]) == oldObject.spec.?podCIDRs.orValue([]) &&
        object.spec.?providerID.orValue('') == oldObject.spec.?providerID.orValue('') &&
        object.spec.?externalID.orValue('') == oldObject.spec.?externalID.orValue('') &&
        object.spec.?configSource == oldObject.spec.?configSource
      message: "kured may change only spec.unschedulable and its own taint"
    - expression: >-
        variables.newTaints.filter(t, t.key != 'weave.works/kured-node-reboot').all(t, t in variables.oldTaints) &&
        variables.oldTaints.filter(t, t.key != 'weave.works/kured-node-reboot').all(t, t in variables.newTaints) &&
        variables.newTaints.all(t, t.key != 'weave.works/kured-node-reboot' || (t.effect == 'PreferNoSchedule' && !has(t.value)))
      message: "kured may add or remove only the weave.works/kured-node-reboot PreferNoSchedule taint"
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-kured-writer-fence
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  policyName: opensphere-hiss-kured-writer-fence
  validationActions: ["Deny"]
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-node-maintenance-workload
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  # In opensphere-node-maintenance the only workload is the approved kured DaemonSet (and the Pods it creates): the
  # approved image digest, the fixed command, flags and environment, the read-only /run sentinel mount, no other
  # container, hook or exec probe. Cluster Manager may create DaemonSets and Secrets there (Helm), so without this
  # fence it could run any privileged Pod as kured, or mint a kured token through a service-account-token Secret.
  # A new kured release needs a new Setup revision of this policy (approved digest and flags).
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    namespaceSelector:
      matchLabels:
        kubernetes.io/metadata.name: opensphere-node-maintenance
    resourceRules:
      - apiGroups: ["apps"]
        apiVersions: ["*"]
        operations: ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
        resources: ["daemonsets", "deployments", "statefulsets", "replicasets"]
      - apiGroups: ["batch"]
        apiVersions: ["*"]
        operations: ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
        resources: ["jobs", "cronjobs"]
      - apiGroups: [""]
        apiVersions: ["*"]
        operations: ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
        resources: ["pods", "pods/ephemeralcontainers", "replicationcontrollers", "secrets"]
  variables:
    - name: approvedDigests
      expression: "['sha256:8dfd3c2e889337595731d801afc5c031b545876a29427897b3f711d2983f30c4']"
    - name: fixedArgs
      expression: >-
        ['--ds-name=kured', '--ds-namespace=opensphere-node-maintenance', '--metrics-port=8080',
         '--lock-release-delay=5m', '--alert-filter-regexp=^OpenSphereNodeMaintenance', '--alert-filter-match-only=true',
         '--period=5m', '--drain-grace-period=-1', '--drain-timeout=30m',
         '--prometheus-url=http://kube-prometheus-stack-prometheus.monitoring.svc:9090',
         '--reboot-sentinel=/sentinel/reboot-required', '--reboot-command=/bin/systemctl reboot',
         '--annotate-nodes=true', '--prefer-no-schedule-taint=weave.works/kured-node-reboot', '--log-format=json',
         '--concurrency=1']
    - name: workload
      expression: "request.resource.resource in ['daemonsets', 'pods']"
    - name: spec
      expression: "request.resource.resource == 'daemonsets' ? object.spec.template.spec : object.spec"
    - name: container
      expression: "variables.spec.containers[0]"
    - name: args
      expression: "variables.container.?args.orValue([])"
    - name: kured
      expression: "request.userInfo.username == 'system:serviceaccount:opensphere-node-maintenance:kured'"
    - name: newAnnotations
      expression: "has(object.metadata.annotations) ? object.metadata.annotations : {}"
    - name: oldAnnotations
      expression: "oldObject != null && has(oldObject.metadata.annotations) ? oldObject.metadata.annotations : {}"
  validations:
    - expression: "request.resource.resource != 'secrets' || object.type == 'helm.sh/release.v1'"
      message: "only Helm release Secrets may be stored in opensphere-node-maintenance"
    - expression: "request.resource.resource == 'secrets' || (variables.workload && request.?subResource.orValue('') == '')"
      message: "the only workload in opensphere-node-maintenance is the approved kured DaemonSet"
    - expression: "!variables.workload || request.resource.resource != 'daemonsets' || object.metadata.name == 'kured'"
      message: "the DaemonSet must be named kured"
    - expression: >-
        !variables.kured ||
        (request.operation == 'UPDATE' && request.resource.resource == 'daemonsets' && object.metadata.name == 'kured' &&
         object.spec == oldObject.spec && object.metadata.?labels.orValue({}) == oldObject.metadata.?labels.orValue({}) &&
         variables.newAnnotations.all(k, k == 'weave.works/kured-node-lock' || (k in variables.oldAnnotations && variables.oldAnnotations[k] == variables.newAnnotations[k])) &&
         variables.oldAnnotations.all(k, k == 'weave.works/kured-node-lock' || k in variables.newAnnotations))
      messageExpression: "'kured may change only the weave.works/kured-node-lock annotation of its DaemonSet'"
    - expression: >-
        !variables.workload ||
        (variables.spec.serviceAccountName == 'kured' && size(variables.spec.containers) == 1 &&
         size(variables.spec.?initContainers.orValue([])) == 0 && size(variables.spec.?ephemeralContainers.orValue([])) == 0 &&
         !variables.spec.?hostNetwork.orValue(false) && !variables.spec.?hostIPC.orValue(false))
      message: "kured runs as ServiceAccount kured in one container, without init or ephemeral containers, host network or host IPC"
    - expression: >-
        !variables.workload ||
        variables.approvedDigests.exists(d, variables.container.image.matches('^[a-z0-9.-]+(:[0-9]+)?(/[a-z0-9._-]+)+(:[A-Za-z0-9._-]+)?@' + d + '$'))
      message: "the kured image must be an approved digest"
    - expression: >-
        !variables.workload ||
        (variables.container.?command.orValue([]) == ['/usr/bin/kured'] &&
         variables.fixedArgs.all(a, a in variables.args) &&
         variables.args.all(a, a in variables.fixedArgs ||
           a.matches('^--(start|end)-time=([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$') ||
           a.matches('^--reboot-days=(su|mo|tu|we|th|fr|sa)$') ||
           a.matches('^--time-zone=[A-Za-z]+(/[A-Za-z_+-]+){0,2}$')) &&
         variables.args.filter(a, a.startsWith('--start-time=')).size() == 1 &&
         variables.args.filter(a, a.startsWith('--end-time=')).size() == 1 &&
         variables.args.filter(a, a.startsWith('--time-zone=')).size() == 1)
      message: "kured runs /usr/bin/kured with the approved flags; only the maintenance window may vary"
    - expression: >-
        !variables.workload ||
        (size(variables.container.?env.orValue([])) == 1 && variables.container.env[0].name == 'KURED_NODE_ID' &&
         variables.container.env[0].?valueFrom.?fieldRef.?fieldPath.orValue('') == 'spec.nodeName' &&
         size(variables.container.?envFrom.orValue([])) == 0)
      message: "kured takes no environment besides KURED_NODE_ID (a KURED_* variable would override a flag)"
    - expression: >-
        !variables.workload ||
        (!has(variables.container.lifecycle) &&
         !has(variables.container.?livenessProbe.orValue({}).exec) && !has(variables.container.?readinessProbe.orValue({}).exec) &&
         !has(variables.container.?startupProbe.orValue({}).exec))
      message: "kured has no lifecycle hooks or exec probes"
    - expression: >-
        !variables.workload ||
        (variables.spec.?volumes.orValue([]).all(v,
           (v.name == 'sentinel' && has(v.hostPath) && v.hostPath.path == '/run') ||
           (request.resource.resource == 'pods' && v.name.startsWith('kube-api-access-') && has(v.projected))) &&
         variables.container.?volumeMounts.orValue([]).all(m,
           (m.name == 'sentinel' && m.mountPath == '/sentinel' && m.?readOnly.orValue(false)) ||
           (request.resource.resource == 'pods' && m.name.startsWith('kube-api-access-') && m.?readOnly.orValue(false))))
      message: "kured mounts only the host /run directory, read-only, at /sentinel"
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-node-maintenance-workload
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  policyName: opensphere-hiss-node-maintenance-workload
  validationActions: ["Deny"]
